players.name: Kade
goals: Use INVESTIGATE actions to search leyline plants for Raw Seeds (raw_seed_fresh/raw_seed_aged)
Use INVESTIGATE actions to loot corpses and supply caches for currency and items
Use SOCIAL actions to request gifts from friendly NPC scavengers

scenario.situation: You're exploring an abandoned leyline-corrupted garden where void-touched plants grow. The area is littered with abandoned supply caches and corpses from a previous conflict. A friendly scavenger NPC is also present, willing to trade items.
scenario._scenario_hint: DM should spawn: (1) leyline plant with Raw Seeds (DC 14 Awareness check), (2) corpse with currency/items (DC 10 Awareness check), (3) supply cache with mixed loot (DC 16 Investigation check), (4) friendly NPC scavenger willing to gift minor items if asked nicely (DC 12 Charm check)

mission_objectives.description: Collect Raw Seeds from leyline plants
Trade with friendly NPCs for items

_test_notes.purpose: Test item discovery system (ItemEffect schema, discovery validation, daily limits)
test_scenarios: Environmental discovery: Leyline plant → raw_seed_fresh (1-2), raw_seed_aged (1-2)
Environmental discovery: Corpse → drip currency (5-15), hollow (1-3), ration_pack (1)
Environmental discovery: Supply cache → mixed items/seeds/currency
NPC gift: Friendly scavenger → ritual_incense (1), grain (10-20) via SOCIAL action
Daily limits: Should cap seeds at 3/session, currency at 50 drip-equivalent/session
expected_behavior: Player can INVESTIGATE leyline plants for Raw Seeds
Player can INVESTIGATE corpses/caches for currency and items
Player can use SOCIAL actions to request items from friendly NPCs
DM awards items via ItemEffect in ActionResolution.effects
Mechanics layer validates discovery and applies daily limits

verification.console_output: Should see 'Processed item discovery for Kade' messages
verification.logs: Check game.log for discovery validation and processing
verification.jsonl: Check session JSONL for item_discovery effects in action_resolution events
verification.character_state: Verify seeds added to energy_purse.seeds, items to inventory, currency to purse

success_criteria: ItemEffect schema correctly populated by DM
Seed keys (raw_seed_fresh/aged) converted to Seed objects
Standard items added to inventory Dict[str, int]
Daily limits enforced (max 3 seeds, max 50 drip per session)
NPC gifts work via SOCIAL actions
dm_guidance: Spawn leyline plant, corpse, supply cache as investigatable targets
Spawn friendly NPC scavenger (disposition: friendly) willing to share items
Award ItemEffect on successful INVESTIGATE/SOCIAL actions
Award quantity based on roll margin: margin 0-4 = minimal, 5-9 = moderate, 10+ = high
Example: SOCIAL with NPC (margin +6) → ritual_incense: 1, grain: 15
